name: OVBench
intro: OVBench 面向在线视频时空理解，以过去、当前和未来三类时间语境组织 6 类任务与 16 个子任务；固定 HF 版本包含 1,463 个视频和 7,090 道选择题。
org: Nanjing University, China Mobile Research Institute, OpenGVLab, Shanghai AI Laboratory
build_method: 仅从源数据集验证集/测试集取样，复用时间戳、边界框、动作和轨迹标注，由人工按任务模板重写问答并构造同视频跨时间干扰项，经清晰度、歧义和准确性检查后裁剪与平衡样本。
metric: 论文：16 个子任务准确率的无权宏平均；固定 LMMS 实现：排除空预测后的样本级微平均准确率
task_type: 在线视频理解, 多项选择问答
eval_feature: 过去、当前与未来时间上下文, 滑动窗口与流式评测
scale: 固定 HF 版 1,463 个视频、7,090 道问题（6 类任务/16 个子任务）；固定 Git LMMS 数据为 1,441 个视频、7,005 条记录
build_method_en: Use validation/test splits only; reuse timestamp, bounding-box, action, and trajectory labels; have humans rewrite task templates and construct same-video cross-time distractors; then manually check, trim, and balance the samples.
eval_feature_en: Past, current, and future temporal contexts; sliding-window and streaming evaluation
intro_en: OVBench evaluates online-video spatiotemporal understanding through past, current, and future contexts, organized into 6 task types and 16 subtasks. The pinned Hugging Face release contains 1,463 videos and 7,090 multiple-choice questions.
scale_en: Pinned HF release: 1,463 videos and 7,090 questions across 6 task types and 16 subtasks; pinned Git LMMS data: 1,441 videos and 7,005 rows
metric_en: Paper: unweighted 16-subtask macro accuracy; fixed harness: item-level micro accuracy after excluding empty predictions

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-18. Evidence lock: the reviewed paper is arXiv:2501.00584v2; PDF SHA-256 cc6c55744d257942183b6563cda6dfecf87ea77a329a934457cd7b1ef842a860 and arXiv source-tar SHA-256 9d90586321b6820d2747f4788b40fa17219c8a6cf42710e67c99757f324434ae. The official VideoChat-Online Git revision is 012712affb74681b88a317656a1effcf7b095933. The official MCG-NJU/OVBench Hugging Face revision is 4d9ddfa3ba1464997d504ecdd4a6db2af801df01; its root ovbench.json SHA-256 is f9771588ae29e0e31e38d4f6622136b4cf0548f6eeae2aab5580be3ebd8334ea. The fixed official scorer utility SHA-256 is 3e15767cc6b68c8c751555a61753135cc1e6e6de250200bb39685a183e3a7df3. Construction trace: OVBench defines Past, Current, and Future contexts around each question timestamp and realizes 6 task types with 16 subtasks: Spatial Perception, Temporal Perception, Spatiotemporal Perception, Past Memory, Temporal Hallucination Verification, and Future Prediction. Only source validation/test splits are selected to reduce potential leakage. Existing timestamps, bounding boxes, action labels, object information, and trajectories are reused. Human annotators rewrite task-specific templates. Distractors come from shifted timestamps in the same video, similar questions or objects, and typical but wrong responses. Manual QC checks question clarity, option ambiguity, and annotation accuracy. Videos are trimmed from the earliest relevant question; duration-proportional sampling, scene diversity, and task balance are retained. Count reconciliation: the paper introduction says seven source datasets, while Section 3.2 says eight datasets across six domains; this is an intra-paper inconsistency and is not normalized away. The pinned HF release contains exactly 1,463 video records and 7,090 nested questions, including 1,774 two-option, 72 three-option, and 5,244 four-option questions. It exposes ten storage prefixes (COIN, HiREST, HACS, AVA, LaSOT, BDD, ArgoVerse, YFCC100M, Charades, and AVA_RAW); these filesystem prefixes are not relabeled as ten source datasets. Evaluation trace: the paper sliding-window protocol supplies the prior 32 seconds at 2 fps, hence at most 64 frames. The paper streaming protocol supplies frames from clip start through the query timestamp at 2 fps. The paper Table 2 AVG was independently recomputed as the unweighted mean of all 16 subtask accuracies. The fixed harness instead parses A–E or matching option text and reports item-level micro accuracy over non-empty predictions; empty predictions are excluded from its denominator. Therefore the paper macro contract and current harness micro contract remain separate. Repository drift: four fixed LMMS configs (AVA, COIN, HiREST, and TAO) contain 1,441 unique videos and 7,005 flattened rows, not the HF release totals. The paper-aligned sliding shell uses 2 fps and 32 seconds. The repository streaming shell defaults to 8 fps, whereas the paper specifies 2 fps; the diagram marks this as implementation drift instead of silently adopting it. Artifact boundary: the HF dataset card declares MIT metadata, the reviewed Git root has no LICENSE file despite an MIT badge in the README, and source-video copyrights and upstream dataset terms still apply. The public project leaderboard supports has_leaderboard=true. The bilingual specs use identical 20-node/22-edge topology, academic-paper profile, academic-color theme, horizontal layout, orthogonal routing, and explicit dashed styling for every evidence or drift edge. Formal publication evidence [site-a11z-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2209×961 (English) and 2209×961 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2207×959 and 2207×959. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
